title: Can We Break LLMs Out of Self-Loops? Fine-Grained Reasoning Control with Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2607.18100v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Extended reasoning is now standard for frontier Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the trajectories they produce remain largely uncontrolled, and inference-time methods for shaping them act mostly at the input or token level. We take a transition-level view: treating each reasoning trace as a sequence of latent states, we show that failing traces tend to get stuck in self-loops that re-enter the same state without progress. We then ask a narrow controllability question: can an inference-time activation intervention drive the model out of its current latent state on the next step? and answer it with SOPHIA: Steering Of reasoning Processes via Hidden-state Intervention and Activations. Training-free, SOPHIA extracts per source state a contrastive residual-stream direction that separates steps exiting the state from steps that stay, and applies it through an online self-loop detector. translated_title: 我们能让大语言模型跳出自我循环吗？基于激活引导的细粒度推理控制
translated_abstract: 扩展推理如今已成为前沿大语言模型（LLM）的标准配置，然而其产生的推理轨迹在很大程度上仍不受控制，且现有的推理时干预方法大多作用于输入或词元层面。我们采用转换层面的视角：将每条推理轨迹视为一系列潜在状态组成的序列，并证明失败的推理轨迹往往陷入自我循环，即不断重新进入相同状态而毫无进展。进而，我们提出一个狭窄的可控性问题：推理时的激活干预能否在下一步驱动模型脱离其当前潜在状态？并用SOPHIA（通过隐藏状态干预与激活引导推理过程）回答了该问题。SOPHIA无需训练，它为每个源状态提取一个对比性残差流方向，用以区分离开该状态的步骤与停留在该状态的步骤，并通过在线自循环检测器加以应用。在三个模型和四个数据集上，SOPHIA提升了……
tldr: 提出免训练的SOPHIA方法，通过为每个潜在状态提取对比性激活方向并配合在线自循环检测器，在推理时将陷入自我循环的LLM推理轨迹引导脱离当前状态，实现了转换层面的细粒度推理控制。
en_tdlr: SOPHIA is a training-free activation steering method that extracts contrastive residual-stream directions per latent state and applies them via an online self-loop detector, enabling fine-grained transition-level control that breaks LLMs out of self-loop reasoning states.
